caption: Original Generic scope and Native support are separate row universes. Quality includes 21 vendor Full companion observations and 12 additions; failures are retained.
Both endpoints complete the same task. Three-repetition medians; black marks are descriptive within-model/setup medians. Runtime conditions are not controlled equivalently; no causal speedup claim.

Base correlations exist only for the three YOLO26m groups (n=3); gray rings coincide with their unchanged augmented estimates. The other nine base groups have n<3 and no base estimate. Every augmented YOLO group has n=3. Top-3 at n=3 is tautological. Top-1 regret=(best Native FPS / FPS selected by Generic)-1.

Split cases only. Throughput and energy share each measured energy window; 60-s screening, three repeats, whole-system energy, no idle subtraction. Hollow red marks preserve accuracy_loss. Pareto membership is computed separately within exact precision/endpoint/calibration strata, not across panels or Full baselines.

All 204 matched cases shown without pooled rank/regression claims. Quality loss has task-specific meaning and unchanged acceptance margins. CV uses sample SD / mean FPS; only three repetitions per case.
